# How to Escape?
This page explains how to cause a containment breach if you are assigned the role of SCP-082.
[textlink="General information about Fernand" link="Scp082About"]
[textlink="More information on containing Fernand as facility personnel" link="Scp082Containment"]
## Main Method
This method involves using the anger mechanic.
[textlink="More information about the anger mechanic and abilities" link="Scp082Abilities"]
Every 30 seconds without food, you become angrier, and your damage and attack speed increase.
Eventually, if personnel go too long without giving you human flesh, you gain the ability to: - Open any airlock - Attack any personnel (ONLY to eat) - Move freely around the facility
## How to Resist Capture?
After you leave your containment chamber, personnel will begin trying to capture you.
Fernand does not have to resist capture, but let us assume it is necessary in your situation.
You have few abilities that can help you avoid defeat, so simply use combat mode and run away if there are too many opponents.
